title: Restore canonical inquiry form entry and validate inquiry commercial commitment
description: Make the existing inquiry menu usable through its already implemented canonical EF main/detail module. modules-doc.js already registers inquiry-new with api/inquiries, but BILL_CODE_MAP in bill-v2.js still maps inquiry-new to the legacy inquiry family, so routing can choose a legacy stored-procedure writer whose ERP-404 policy deliberately refuses every write. Route the existing menu to the canonical module using canonical Ids only; preserve legacy reads and never map legacy Oid to canonical Id or enable legacy write adapters. Inquiry.InquiryNo has [Required] although InquiryController.Create allocates the number server-side; allow an omitted number to reach the authorized action while refusing client state/identity injection. Create and update currently multiply unchecked quantity and price, persist an unchecked Currency/ExchangeRate/ValidDays and consume the number before validation. Add bounded server validation/amount normalization shared by manual create/update and operational submit/approve/quotation conversion. Keep supported empty drafts, but commitment requires valid lines. Reuse the existing authorized default endpoint and preserve integer-day input/default failure behavior. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: The existing authorized inquiry-new entry opens the canonical api/inquiries main/detail form and list; genuine HTTP new inquiry without a client number persists and returns a server number and canonical Id, edit/submit/approve then quotation conversion are reachable under current authority. Legacy rows remain separate readable history and every legacy write remains fail closed.

Before number reservation or persistence reject undefined currency, nonpositive/overprecision rate, nonpositive line quantity, negative price, persisted precision/overflow, soft-deleted detail injection and invalid bounded integral validity days. Derive active-line amounts by existing currency precision/rounding; valid empty drafts remain supported but operational commitment requires valid lines and rechecks stored values.

Genuine isolated SQL/HTTP and browser tests cover blank-number create, main/detail save/reload/edit, authorized state flow and conversion, invalid zero-mutation/zero-numbering cases, list/form canonical routing and separation from legacy identities. Browser uses a real test database and real authorized identity, never mocked successful business writes. Preserve existing defaults, tabs, new-page/drawer behavior and all unit regressions; run safe Release/full units.
implementation_evidence: modules-doc.js:84 registers inquiry-new canonical module; bill-v2.js:21 retains inquiry-new legacy mapping. BillProcController.Save:112 invokes GuardLegacyMutationAsync before the explicitly unreachable sp_Biz write path; LegacyBillMutationRules documents HasValidatedAdapter=false. Inquiry.cs InquiryNo uses Required with empty default while InquiryController.Create generates a number; Create/Update multiply detail values without a commercial contract. ERP-469 covers manual-test UI defaults but leaves this canonical/legacy routing and model-binding conflict.
